thread:
maya: Draft release notes for the small rollout tomorrow — focusing on the 'waitlist' flow change and a minor caching fix. Need ops + product signoff by EOD. TL;DR:
- Waitlist: users now see an explicit 'queued' state instead of a spinner.
- Dedup cache: reduce duplicate inference calls for identical session tokens.
- Hotfix: backoff on 429s to avoid thundering herd.

ev: quick ask — are we pinning model-serving to a build hash or floating to latest?

maya: pin to rwinf-serv:v2.3.1-build-58 for prod. Staging will run v2.3.1-build-60 (perf checks).

sam: rollback criteria proposal: error rate > 1.5% sustained for 10m OR P95 latency > 950ms for 5m. Also any user-facing regressions from the waitlist UX test.

lia: who is oncall for this window? I can cover the first 2 hours of the change window, ev can take the handoff after.

ev: yep I can take 02:00–06:00 UTC slot. I'll be the escalation owner.

deploy-bot: Automated: planned deploy created by @maya — staging -> prod.
Schedule: 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z start. Canary: 5% (15m), 25% (30m), 100% (after checks).
Canary checks: error_rate < 0.8%, P95 < 700ms, no increase in 429s.
Command preview:
```bash
./deploy --service rwinf-serv --image rwinf-serv:v2.3.1-build-58 
  --canary 5,25 --canary-wait 900,1800 --rollback-on error_rate>0.008
```

maya: draft internal blurb for the product/ops channel (one paragraph):
"Tomorrow 02:00 UTC we'll rollout a small UX update for the waitlist state and a backend dedupe/caching fix. We're pinning to rwinf-serv:v2.3.1-build-58 for prod and will canary progressively. Expect brief read-only behavior for queued users during the 5% canary window. If you see increased errors, page the infra oncall and we'll roll back to v2.3.0 immediately."

sam: suggestion — add a short note about the embargo/quiet window: ask PMs not to push marketing messages for 3h after the start.

maya: added: "Embargo: please hold external comms until 05:30 UTC (3.5h after start)."

lia: small nit — include the curl check for the health endpoint in the RN so SREs have a quick verification:
```bash
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_READ_TOKEN' https://rwinf-prod.example/health | jq .status
```

maya: good call. also adding canary watchlist: auth, inference, cache.

ev: acked. I'll run the canary checklist and keep #eng-oncall updated. If threshold breached, immediate rollback and send 1-line update to #product.

sam: :thumbsup: Approving RN copy and embargo. ops: please confirm you're ready to standby.

lia: Standby ready. I have the rollback command and snapshot id in my notes.

maya: thanks everyone — I'll push the internal announce to #product at 20:00 PST and to #eng-ops 30m before the window. Night owls: feel free to DM for walk-throughs.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: notify #eng-oncall 15 minutes before start.

maya: (final) publishing RN now to the shared draft folder; updating the doc with the pinned hash and the 3 rollback triggers.

ev: copy. I'll be on deck for the release and will post canary metrics to the thread during the rollout.

sam: thanks — nice and compact. :party_parrot:
